description: Returns an UNSIGNED transaction {chainId, to, data, value} plus `simulation` — an eth_call of exactly it from `from` (ok, or the revert decoded by name) — `warnings` and `next`. This server signs nothing: the sender signs and sends it with their own wallet and pays the gas. Owner only. An operator may rebalance (allocate, recenter, move, claim, reinvest) inside the manager's pools and can never withdraw. To hand a manager to an operator agent, allow the address of the local envelop-mcp-lp server's operator wallet.

allowed.description: true adds the operator, false revokes it

chainId.description: EVM chain id: 8453 Base, 42161 Arbitrum, 130 Unichain (1 = Ethereum mainnet, your gas)

from.description: The address that will send the transaction — the manager owner (ownerOf(1)). The simulation runs from it.

operator.description: The operator address to allow or revoke (for an agent: the operator wallet of the local envelop-mcp-lp server)

name: prepare_set_operator
title: Owner tx: allow or revoke an operator
